text.card: A red giant 4,095 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.79 solar masses and 12.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,850 K at its surface.
